review.feedback: The three statements are mathematically sound with sufficient positivity and nonzero hypotheses. alpha_gt_three correctly derives alpha>3 from 0<S, 162S<T, and alpha^3=T/(6S). curve_approximation_bound matches the v9 curve equation with x=n-1 and, under n>=104, 3n<r, and the strict T bounds, proves exactly the stated two-sided 3/(2(n-1)^2) bound. reduced_approximation_bound correctly transfers the bound from r/x to p/q using r=gp, x=gq, and g,q>0; it does not assert coprimality, but none is needed for this inequality, so the name is not overstating. The module does not claim CF completeness or the final theorem.
